## What changed

Describe the exact change and its boundaries. Explain any difference from the claimed scope and link the coordination that approved it.

## File versions and hashes

For each input and output, give the public-safe asset alias, version, repository-relative path where applicable, and full SHA-256. The alias-to-private-file mapping stays in an owner-controlled private handoff. State which output version the evidence below shows.

Keep `.blend` files, ZIPs, raw LiDAR, heavy textures, and render caches in owner-controlled private storage. This public repository does not grant access to those files or the private Project. Never paste private storage IDs or links, local machine paths, account emails, credentials, tokens, or signed download URLs.

## Before requesting review

- [ ] This pull request stays within the claimed task and has no unresolved overlapping edit.
- [ ] The actual reference images and exported stills were inspected.
- [ ] Geometry claims are supported by evidence; estimates and unknowns are labeled.
- [ ] File versions, SHA-256 hashes, dimensions, still evidence, dependencies, and handoff are supplied.
- [ ] `docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md` in this repository is completed or its blocked items are identified.
- [ ] All video work remains paused, and no Pine Barrens work is included.
- [ ] No access change, publication, deployment, spending, or repository-protection promise is implied by this pull request.

A polished render or embedded metadata alone does not verify geometry. Claim expiration does not authorize another worker to take over.
